source_policy.method_note: Hard-cut and shot-length numbers are low-resolution histogram proxies used only as comparative evidence. They are not official analytics and do not identify dissolves or hidden cuts perfectly.

story_energy_wave.pass: opening promise, build, readable breath and payoff are distinct; shot length varies with meaning
story_energy_wave.block: one constant high-speed rhythm or logo before evidence

shot_coverage_and_camera_motivation.pass: context wide, action medium, proof detail and reaction/consequence cover one idea; movement serves subject or reveal
shot_coverage_and_camera_motivation.block: digital push or drift added only because the frame feels empty

continuity_and_transition_motivation.pass: screen direction, eyeline, action, scale, anchor or real occlusion proves the transition
continuity_and_transition_motivation.block: transition pack, generic circle wipe, arbitrary geometry, unexplained glitch or unverified match cut

sound_picture_integration.pass: dialogue/sync sound, production sound, room tone and specific foley lead; J/L cuts open scenes before picture
sound_picture_integration.block: generic whoosh on every cut or BGM masking missing production sound

colour_and_shot_matching.pass: input transform, exposure/white balance, shot matching, restrained look and output transform are separated
colour_and_shot_matching.block: hard LUT stack, clipped highlights, false skin/product colour or inconsistent adjacent shots

information_graphics.pass: graphics explain scale, process, location, measurement or comparison and inherit frame hierarchy
information_graphics.block: role labels, generic full-screen cards, grid opener or decorative HUD without information

vfx_compositing_truth.pass: track, matte, perspective, blur, lighting, occlusion and grain agree with the plate
vfx_compositing_truth.block: mask leak, floating asset, fake depth, untracked label or effect used as a transition without a cut reason

restraint_and_payoff_readability.pass: effect density drops when evidence needs reading; payoff receives a clean hold and specific sound or silence
restraint_and_payoff_readability.block: the strongest moment is covered by text, particles, transition or an unrelated card

format_application.longform: Preserve spatial logic, answer duration and sound bridges; allow longer evidence and breath shots.
format_application.shorts: Compress setup and context, not proof or payoff; keep the same continuity and sound requirements.

score_contract.human_review: Hao must timestamp-review every exported video.
